From First Call To Shipped Product

Every engagement moves through the same four stages — it keeps scope honest and nothing gets rushed to fit a deadline.

01

Discovery

We start with questions. Your brand, your audience, what you're building and why. I listen more than I talk at this stage.

02

Strategy

A clear positioning, a defined voice, and a direction for the visual system. Everything that follows grows from here.

03

Design

Logo, type, color, and the supporting system, built with intention. We review together and refine until it feels exactly right.

04

Delivery

Final files, guidelines, and a walkthrough of how to use everything. You leave with a brand you can actually work with.

Frequently Asked Questions

If it's not answered here, the fastest way to get a real answer is to just ask.

A focused MVP usually runs 3–6 weeks. Full products with design, build and an agent layer typically run 6–12 weeks, depending on scope and how much of the system already exists.

Most of the founders I work with are non-technical. Part of the job is translating between "what you want the product to do" and what actually gets built — you shouldn't need to speak the stack.

An agent is software that can carry out a task on its own — answering customers, qualifying leads, following up — rather than just displaying information. Not every product needs one; I'll tell you honestly if a simpler build serves you better.

Yes — that's the point. Interfaces designed without knowledge of what's technically sane tend to fall apart at build time; I design and build so nothing gets lost in a handoff.

That's fine — I can slot into a specific piece, most often the agentic/AI layer, and work alongside your existing team rather than replacing it.
